q: How do I reset my password?
a: Go to Settings > Security > Reset password, or use 'Forgot password' on the login page. A reset link is emailed to you.

q: Can I import data from Trello or Asana?
a: Yes. Go to Settings > Import and choose Trello, Asana or CSV.

q: How do I cancel my subscription?
a: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. You keep access until the end of the billing period.
